claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.kernel
claims.statement: kernel trace first second means equal trace values.
claims.ceiling: A kernel is an equality relation only.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.jointTrace
claims.statement: Pair two trace values at each world.
claims.ceiling: A product trace does not establish cooperation.
claims.residual: Reachability may be a proper product subset.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.Reachable
claims.statement: Reachable values are trace values with a supplied preimage witness.
claims.ceiling: No decoder is defined on unreachable ambient values.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.Certifies
claims.statement: Certification is a decoder on the reachable trace subtype agreeing at every world.
claims.residual: Decoder class is unrestricted set-theoretic functions.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.joint_kernel_eq_intersection
claims.statement: The joint trace kernel equals conjunction of component kernels.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.reachable_certifies_iff_kernel_subset
claims.statement: A reachable decoder exists iff each trace-equal pair has equal answers.
claims.ceiling: Reachable subtype only; no ambient total decoder.
claims.residual: Computability and restricted decoder classes absent.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.common_collision_blocks_joint_certification
assumptions: One shared component collision and conflicting answers.
claims.statement: A pair collapsed by both components cannot be jointly certified.
claims.ceiling: Blocks only the declared paired trace.
claims.residual: Other traces or side information are outside scope.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.xor_first_insufficient
claims.statement: No reachable decoder for XOR from the first coordinate alone.
claims.residual: No statement about other answer functions.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.xor_second_insufficient
claims.statement: No reachable decoder for XOR from the second coordinate alone.
claims.residual: No statement about other answer functions.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.xor_pair_certifies
claims.statement: The paired coordinates certify XOR on the reachable image.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.xor_strict_joint_sufficiency
claims.statement: XOR is jointly certified while neither coordinate is sufficient.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.collapsedTrace
claims.statement: Constant Boolean trace for the shared-collision fixture.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.firstBitAnswer
claims.statement: First-bit answer for the shared-collision fixture.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.common_collision_negative_fixture
claims.statement: A concrete pair shares the constant trace while its first-bit answers conflict.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.common_collision_negative_blocks_joint
claims.statement: Two constant component traces cannot jointly certify the conflicting first-bit answer.

manual_dispositions.detail: P0025-P0026 capacity claims are deliberately not formalized.
Causal, cooperation, coalition, and physical interpretations are outside this function-level realization.
